statements.status_notes: Uptime Kuma 1.x ships vue-i18n 9.14.5 and @intlify/core-base 9.14.5. CVE-2026-118256 is fixed in vue-i18n 11.4.14. The vue-i18n advisory GHSA-8rc2-428q-7ww3 states that v9 and v10 will not receive that fix. Adopting 11.4.14 on this line is a two-major upgrade and is still under assessment.
